title: Bent Functions from Cellular Automata
summary: Connects CA constructions to bent functions and therefore to special Hadamard-type spectral structure.

title: Heuristic Search of (Semi-)Bent Functions based on Cellular Automata
summary: Shows CA rule and seed evolution can be used to search for spectrally flat Boolean objects.

title: Convolution numbers: the cyclic case

title: Combinatorial Designs and Cellular Automata: A Survey
